history_summary: Record four GTDB species-reference correspondences while preserving five optimized rumen stocks and the existing Streptococcus ambiguity.
history_details: The exact pinned crosswalk supplies a species-name fallback for Lactobacillus delbrueckii 5812 with total 376 reference genomes and majority fraction 1.0, and exact NCBI species-ID routes for Proteiniphilum acetatigenes 6076 with total 1/fraction 1.0, Enterococcus lactis 6088 to Enterococcus_B lactis with total 574/fraction 0.99, and Petrimonas mucosa 6360 with total 7/fraction 1.0. Totals and fractions are generic reference populations, not explicit supporting numerators, experimental abundances, animal or bag counts, deposited study-assembly matches or source-stock genomic identities. No numerator is reconstructed from a rounded fraction. Original NCBI species names and all five stock strings remain unchanged; the GTDB suffix does not rename source stock 6088. Streptococcus equinus 5640 and its complete equinus/pasteurianus/ruminicola ambiguity remain untouched. Native commands processed five descriptors, while only four correspondence blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. Historical unresolved-grounding notes remain prior observations, not a claim that the newly mapped descriptors still lack current correspondences. All source quotations, five-member formulation, earlier design boundaries, three graph nodes, zero downstream arrows and old history remain unchanged. Preserve measured outcomes separately from genomic predictions, nonsignificant endpoints, nested bag subsamples and unproved durable engraftment; reference mappings add no mechanistic or taxon-specific animal-effect claim. Prior non-graph provenance limitations captured under issue 1658 remain unresolved. The crosswalk hash identifies exact bytes without an established release or chronology. This partial technical diagnostic does not complete scientific review, generated products or aggregate QC.
